verified: FAW-Volkswagen has opened pre-orders in China for the ID. Aura L5, a mid-size electric sedan on Volkswagen's CMP platform with a quoted 580 km CLTC range, according to electrive and CarNewsChina, which adds that the car uses the CEA 1.4 electrical architecture.
unconfirmed: No launch date beyond "2026," no prices and no independent range test are given; the 310 kW power figure and frameless doors come from a single Turkish outlet (DonanımHaber), and the reported 99-yuan deposit credited as 2,000 yuan toward purchase appears only in a Russian report, so treat both as unverified.

verified: electrive 与 carnewschina 均报道，一汽-大众已在中国开启 ID. Aura L5 的预订；该车基于大众 CMP 纯电平台，定位中型纯电轿车，厂方公布的 CLTC 续航为 580 公里，carnewschina 称其采用 CEA 1.4 电子电气架构，并将在今年内上市。
unconfirmed: 99 元意向金可抵 2000 元、310 kW 功率、无框车门等细节，仅见于单一海外媒体的转述，未获大众官方确认；580 公里为 CLTC 工况下的厂方数据，尚没有第三方实测，具体上市日期与正式售价也尚未公布。

titles.en: Volkswagen opens China pre-orders for ID. Aura L5 electric sedan
titles.zh: 大众在华开启 ID. Aura L5 预售：CMP 平台、CLTC 续航 580 公里
